metadata.description: Threadlight pilot pipeline — 22 pipeline skills + threadlight-auto agent-guided lifecycle planner (23 total) that take a customer engagement from brief to a working pilot with selected runtime governance and an evidence-backed path to production. Per-binding evidence, not whole-agent certification. It also bundles an optional GitHub Copilot App Lifecycle Canvas.
